text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَيْلٌۭ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ

translations.asad: WOE UNTO THOSE who give short measure:
translations.sahih: Woe to those who give less [than due],

text.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ

translations.asad: those who, when they are to receive their due from [other] people, demand that it be given in full –
translations.sahih: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full.

translations.asad: but when they have to measure or weigh whatever they owe to others, give less than what is due!
translations.sahih: But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss.

translations.asad: Do they not know that they are bound to be raised from the dead
translations.sahih: Do they not think that they will be resurrected

translations.asad: [and called to account] on an awesome Day –
translations.sahih: For a tremendous Day -

translations.asad: the Day when all men shall stand before the Sustainer of all the worlds?
translations.sahih: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?

text.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍۢ

translations.asad: NAY, VERILY, the record of the wicked is indeed [set down] in a mode inescapable!
translations.sahih: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen.

translations.asad: And what could make thee conceive what that that mode inescapable will be?
translations.sahih: And what can make you know what is sijjeen?

translations.asad: A record [indelibly] inscribed!
translations.sahih: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed.

translations.asad: Woe on that Day unto those who give the lie to the truth –
translations.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers,

translations.asad: those who give the lie to the [coming of] Judgment Day:
translations.sahih: Who deny the Day of Recompense.

text.arabic: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ

translations.asad: for, none gives the lie to it but such as are wont to transgress against all that is [and are] immersed in sin:
translations.sahih: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor.

text.arabic: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

translations.asad: [and so,] whenever Our messages are conveyed to them, they but say, "Fables of ancient times!"
translations.sahih: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."

text.arabic: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ

translations.asad: Nay, but their hearts are corroded by all [the evil] that they were wont to do!
translations.sahih: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.

text.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ

translations.asad: Nay, verily, from [the grace of] their Sustainer shall they on that Day be debarred;
translations.sahih: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.

translations.asad: and then, behold, they shall enter the blazing fire
translations.sahih: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire.

text.arabic: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ

translations.asad: and be told: "This is the [very thing] to which you were wont to give the lie!"
translations.sahih: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny."

text.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ

translations.asad: NAY, VERILY - the record of the truly virtuous is [set down] in a mode most lofty!
translations.sahih: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in 'illiyyun.

translations.asad: And what could make thee conceive what that mode most lofty will be?
translations.sahih: And what can make you know what is 'illiyyun?

translations.asad: A record [indelibly] inscribed,
translations.sahih: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed

translations.asad: witnessed~ by all who have [ever] been drawn close unto God.
translations.sahih: Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allah].

translations.asad: Behold, [in the life to come] the truly virtuous will indeed be in bliss:
translations.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure

translations.asad: [resting on couches, they will look up [to God]:
translations.sahih: On adorned couches, observing.

translations.asad: upon their faces thou wilt see the brightness of bliss.
translations.sahih: You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.

translations.asad: They will be given a drink of pure wine whereon the seal [of God] will have been set,
translations.sahih: They will be given to drink [pure] wine [which was] sealed.

text.arabic: خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌۭ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ

translations.asad: pouring forth with a fragrance of musk. To that [wine of paradise], then, let all such aspire as [are willing to] aspire to things of high account:
translations.sahih: The last of it is musk. So for this let the competitors compete.

translations.asad: for it is composed of all that is most exalting
translations.sahih: And its mixture is of Tasneem,

translations.asad: a source [of bliss] whereof those who are drawn close unto God shall drink.
translations.sahih: A spring from which those near [to Allah] drink.

text.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ

translations.asad: BEHOLD, those who have abandoned themselves to sin are wont to laugh at such as have attained to faith
translations.sahih: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.

translations.asad: and whenever they pass by them, they wink at one another [derisively];
translations.sahih: And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances.

text.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ

translations.asad: and whenever they return to people of their own kind, they return full of jests;
translations.sahih: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.

text.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ

translations.asad: and whenever they see those [who believe,] they say, "Behold, these [people] have indeed gone astray!"
translations.sahih: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."

translations.asad: And, withal, they have no call to watch over [the beliefs of] others...
translations.sahih: But they had not been sent as guardians over them.

text.arabic: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ

translations.asad: But on the Day [of Judgment], they who had attained to faith will [be able to] laugh at the [erstwhile] deniers of the truth:
translations.sahih: So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,

translations.asad: [for, resting in paradise] on couches, they will look on [and say to themselves]:
translations.sahih: On adorned couches, observing.

text.arabic: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ

translations.asad: "Are these deniers of the truth being [thus] requited for [aught but] what they were wont to do?"
translations.sahih: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do?
